biotools.summary: Easy-MODA is a web-based tool developed on the Enalos Cloud Platform that simplifies the creation of MODA documentation for materials modelling workflows, facilitating registration and improving FAIRness. It assists users in creating detailed MODA documentation even for complex models and integrates with the broader MODA guidelines.
